l4_patch.reason: Scope-dependent. Golf courses are licensed at Menengah and Besar scale as Tinggi risk (PP 28/2025 Lampiran I.L.61), outside the Rendah / Menengah Rendah tiers of the Bali moratorium request, and no Perpres reservation was located. All other sports fields (driving range, mini-soccer, badminton, volleyball, basketball, tennis and similar) are licensed only at Mikro/Kecil/Menengah scale as Menengah Rendah risk: in Bali we flag that scope as blocked as a precaution, and whether OSS licenses it for a PT PMA must be confirmed (Permen Investasi/BKPM 5/2025 Pasal 8(6)).

l4_patch.reason: Demolition using simple and intermediate technology is allocated to cooperatives and MSMEs (Koperasi/UMKM) in the dialokasikan column of Perpres 10/2021 as amended by Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran II (p.10, entry 37); a new PT PMA cannot enter that activity, in Bali or elsewhere. Under Pasal 5(5) the reservation does not cover the rest of this code: PP 28/2025 Lampiran I.H entry 39 (pages I.H.224-228) licenses building demolition at every scale as Menengah Tinggi risk, including a Besar-scale route with requirements specific to a foreign-invested construction company (BUJK PMA), and a third row for individual operators (Usaha Orang Perseorangan) at Mikro scale as Menengah Rendah risk, source-verified on I.H.227-228. Whether a PT PMA can use the Besar route depends on the technology and scope declared — confirm it in OSS.
